source_anchors.title: ilastik pixel classification with Live Update
source_anchors.grounding: The source documents selecting a class, scribbling example pixels, training a Random Forest with Live Update, inspecting a whole-image prediction overlay, and iterating with corrective annotations and an eraser.

transformation.original_mechanic: interactive pixel classification and semantic segmentation
transformation.benchmark_mechanic: A self-contained procedural botanical plate whose visible feature field is learned through labeled brush examples and a deterministic local nearest-centroid classifier.
original_elements_not_copied: No ilastik source code, pretrained model, UI artwork, or image assets are bundled.

license_notes: The cited ilastik project is GPL-licensed. This benchmark implementation is original procedural code and does not copy ilastik code or assets; the links are source grounding only.

verification.anti_shortcut: Submitted target labels and prediction arrays are rejected; the grader replays visible brush events and retrains from public pixel features.
